_note: Only the S.No + 'Name of Companies' + Technology + Fuel + Installed Capacity (MW) columns of the FY2017-18 and FY2023-24 NEPRA generation workbooks. Fetched 2026-09-08. The upstream pages are windows-1252; every string here is the cp1252-decoded published cell VERBATIM, including U+00A0 NBSP padding and the embedded newline+indent that Excel's HTML export inserts. Monthly generation columns are deliberately omitted - this package resolves names, it does not parse measurements. installed_capacity_mw_raw is the published string; an empty string means the workbook cell was blank/NBSP-only, i.e. NOT REPORTED, and must never be read as zero.
